2607.07016.title: Multimodal Spatiotemporal-Frequency Fusion with Peak Enhancement for Cellular Traffic Forecasting
2607.07016.paper_summary: Accurate forecasting of cellular network traffic is essential for network planning, resource allocation, and quality-of-service assurance in modern mobile communication systems. Real-world traffic often exhibits bursty endogenous dynamics and disturbances triggered by external urban events, which makes reliable prediction highly challenging. Most existing spatiotemporal traffic forecasting methods primarily focus on intrinsic traffic patterns or structural relationships within a single modality, and rarely model burst behavior together with exogenous contextual signals. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{MSPF-Net}, a multimodal cellular traffic forecasting framework that integrates external contextual information. Specifically, MSPF-Net consists of a Spatiotemporal-Frequency Traffic Encoder for capturing temporal, spatial, and spectral traffic patterns, a Peak Enhancement Module for extracting burst-aware representations of sudden spikes, a News Context Representation Module for encoding urban news streams into exogenous contextual embeddings, and a Dynamic Fusion Prediction Module for adaptively integrating these heterogeneous signals to generate forecasts. Experiments on the Milano, Trento, and LTE traffic datasets demonstrate that jointly modeling traffic dynamics, burst patterns, and news contextual signals can effectively improve forecasting performance.
2607.07016.paper_summary_zh: 準確預測行動網路流量對於網路規劃、資源分配以及現代行動通信系統中的服務品質保證至關重要。實際流量通常表現出突發的內生動態和由外部城市事件觸發的干擾，這使得可靠的預測變得非常具有挑戰性。大多數現有的時空流量預測方法主要集中在單一模態內的內在流量模式或結構關係上，並且很少將突發行為與外生的上下文信號一起建模。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了\textbf{MSPF-Net}，一個整合外部上下文信息的多模態行動流量預測框架。具體而言，MSPF-Net包含一個時空頻率流量編碼器，用於捕捉時間、空間和頻譜流量模式，一個峰值增強模組，用於提取對突發事件敏感的突然激增表示，一個新聞上下文表示模組，用於將城市新聞流編碼為外生上下文嵌入，以及一個動態融合預測模組，用於自適應整合這些異質信號以生成預測。在米蘭、特倫托和LTE流量數據集上的實驗表明，聯合建模流量動態、突發模式和新聞上下文信號可以有效提高預測性能。
